items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: Much more of a groove player like Junior Mance. He loved Junior Mance.

ctx.x: Well don’t get me started on this whole century. Because I’m glad I’m here, I make the best of it, I try, you know I try to get into the advanced things but I really don’t get it.

Although I do appreciate the technology and I appreciate the skill that it takes to manipulate it and what they can do, but I am on the fence. I am seeing more and more people even my age using them. My bass player, one of my steady bass players, Boots Malison, a wonderful, wonderful musician, says that some of his, he calls them “accounts” some of his accounts hand out not music, they hand out an iPad just for this musician for the show. I mean like five iPads they bring to the gig. But I remember — this sticks…
